core_obligations: Set-up (proof lines 2076-2096): the two morphisms are described by index maps and component morphisms, and the assumption that they induce the same map of targets is displayed as a commutative diagram.

The comparison (proof lines 2097-2131): the author compares the two pullback maps on a compatible family, using the commutative diagram and the definition of the compatible families, and concludes that the two induced maps on compatible families coincide.
proof_roadmap: Describe the two morphisms of coverings by their indices and components.
Compare the two pullback operations on a compatible family.
Use the compatibility of the family to conclude equality of the induced maps.
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that two morphisms of coverings which induce the same morphism of the targets give the same map on compatible families (statement lines 2068-2073). The proof is a complete computation: the two morphisms are described by their index maps and component morphisms, with the common map of targets displayed as a commutative diagram (proof lines 2076-2096); and the author compares the two pullback operations on an arbitrary compatible family, using the definition of the compatible families to conclude that the induced maps agree (proof lines 2097-2131). The non-formal content is the comparison of the two pullbacks. The claim is H1/H2: a written-out computation.
